name: Alyson
source:
Alyson is Emily's friend. She is also friends with Kathy. 

She is the only straight woman in the friend group of her, Kathy and Emily. 

 [spoiler] However, she seems particularly close to Emily and she is curious about doing sexual acts with Emily....[spoiler]
